add_leads.label: Add Leads
add_leads.description: Add leads to campaigns dynamically by selecting a campaign, entering lead details, and including custom variables.

campaignId.label: Select Campaign
campaignId.description: Choose a campaign from the list.

email.label: Email Address
email.description: Enter the email address for the lead

firstName.label: First Name
firstName.description: Enter the first name for the lead

lastName.label: Last Name
lastName.description: Enter the last name for the lead

customVariables.label: Custom Variables
customVariables.description: Add custom variables as key-value pairs for the lead, such as [{"key": "company", "value": "Acme"}].

add_leads.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Leads added successfully.', leadCount: response.leadCount };

add_blocklist.label: Add Blocklist
add_blocklist.description: Add email addresses, domains, and keywords to the blocklist.

emails.label: Email Addresses
emails.description: Enter the email addresses to block (e.g., ["abc@gmail.com"])

add_blocklist.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Blocklist updated successfully.' };

add_email.label: Add Email
add_email.description: Add an email to a specific account.

campaignId.label: Select Campaign
campaignId.description: Choose a campaign from the list or enter the campaign ID manually.

email.label: Email
email.description: Enter the email address to add to the campaign.

add_email.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Email added successfully.' };

enable_warmup.label: Enable Warmup
enable_warmup.description: Enable warmup for specific email accounts where it is currently disabled.

accountId.label: Select Email Accounts to Enable Warmup
accountId.description: Choose email accounts that have warmup disabled.

enable_warmup.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Warmup enabled for account ID: ' + inputs.accountId };

pause_warmup.label: Pause Warmup
pause_warmup.description: Pause warmup for selected email accounts.

accountId.label: Select Email Accounts to Pause Warmup
accountId.description: Choose email accounts that are currently warming up.

pause_warmup.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Warmup paused for account ID: ' + inputs.accountId };

remove_email.label: Remove Email
remove_email.description: Remove an email account from the system.

accountId.label: Select Email Account to Remove
accountId.description: Choose an email account to remove.

remove_email.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: 'Email account with ID ' + inputs.accountId + ' was successfully removed.' };

set_schedule.label: Set Schedule
set_schedule.description: Update the schedule for a specific Campaign

campaignId.label: Select Campaign
campaignId.description: Choose a campaign from the list or enter the campaign ID manually.

scheduleName.label: Schedule Name
scheduleName.description: Enter the schedule name here (e.g., New schedule).

sunday.label: Sunday
sunday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Sunday.

monday.label: Monday
monday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Monday.

tuesday.label: Tuesday
tuesday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Tuesday.

wednesday.label: Wednesday
wednesday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Wednesday.

thursday.label: Thursday
thursday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Thursday.

friday.label: Friday
friday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Friday.

saturday.label: Saturday
saturday.description: Choose "Yes" if you want to set a schedule for Saturday.

set_schedule.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Schedule updated successfully.' };

start_campaign.label: Start Campaign

campaignId.label: Select Campaign
campaignId.description: Choose a campaign from the list or enter the campaign ID manually.

start_campaign.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Campaign started successfully.' };

update_lead.label: Update Lead

campaignId.label: Select Campaign
campaignId.description: Choose a campaign from the list or enter the campaign ID manually.

leadId.label: Select Lead
leadId.description: Choose a lead from the selected campaign.

email.label: Email
email.description: Enter the new email address for the lead.

firstName.label: First Name
firstName.description: Enter the new first name for the lead.

lastName.label: Last Name
lastName.description: Enter the new last name for the lead.

customVariables.label: Custom Variables
customVariables.description: Add custom variables as key-value pairs for the lead, such as [{"key": "company", "value": "Acme"}].

update_lead.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: response.message || 'Lead updated successfully.' };
